CORE DEFINITION

SlideForge

/slaɪd fɔːrdʒ/

A 4:5-first slide composition system.

Composition system, not just a renderer.

Why 4:5?

Composition is authored inside a 420×525 base canvas. Final aspect ratios are derived by fitting, not redesigning — backgrounds bleed, content does not recompose.

The slide problem

SOLUTION

Myth vs Fact

MYTH
Slide decks are just static images.
FACT
They are runtime composition decisions against an aspect-ratio canvas.
Every layout is a constraint satisfaction problem at fixed geometry.
